title.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 - Procurement and coordination

description.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 will contribute to enhance human capital development in Africa (Overall Objective). More specifically, it will seek to unlock the potential of education and research through increased access of African education and research institutions to digital infrastructures and technologies (Specific Objective). This contract will cover the procurement and the coordination activities of the whole project and will involve the 4 implementing partners.
